name: Trint
summary: Combines automated transcription with editing tools, facilitating efficient content creation workflows.
description:
Combines automated transcription with editing tools, facilitating efficient content creation workflows.

Fast-track your first draft with Trint's AI-connected media production. Transcribe, translate and collaborate in 50+ languages. Trusted by newsrooms worldwide.

AI audio processing: Trint supports automated audio analysis and enhancements. Transcription support: Provides tools for converting speech to text. Noise reduction: Reduces unwanted sounds from audio input. Voice synthesis: Can generate or clone voices using AI models.
